subject.title: [Bug]: Transcript redaction (`***`) is replayed into model context on session resume — model reuses masked values in new tool calls

question: What recovery policy should OpenClaw use for historical transcripts whose masked-looking call arguments have no provenance marker?
rationale: New records can be handled deterministically, but old `***` and middle-elided strings cannot safely be distinguished from legitimate literal values; automatic deletion or rewriting would alter persisted session history.

options.title: Doctor migration with ambiguity report
options.body: Add a bounded doctor/session migration that backs up affected sessions, removes confidently paired poisoned calls, and asks for confirmation when values are ambiguous.

options.title: Documented session reset
options.body: Protect new transcripts with provenance and require affected users to rotate or reset legacy sessions instead of migrating ambiguous entries.

options.title: Heuristic replay filtering
options.body: Automatically drop historical calls containing masked-looking values during replay, accepting possible removal of legitimate values.

recommendation.title: Doctor migration with ambiguity report
recommendation.body: Add a bounded doctor/session migration that backs up affected sessions, removes confidently paired poisoned calls, and asks for confirmation when values are ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged and carried the central security-sensitive transcript redaction repair and is the strongest history-backed owner for its upgrade policy.
